title: Dot-product upper bounds without complete-ranking stopping
formal_object: Split q=(q_A,q_B), c=(c_A,c_B); current exact top-k threshold tau and UB=q_A c_A+||q_B||||c_B||.
assumptions: Exact arithmetic bound; floating-point error requires conservative outward slack.
Strict UB<tau only certifies exclusion from top-k; ties must be retained.
The native protocol requires complete candidate rankings, including the tail.

operations.output: Residual dot has magnitude at most ||q_B||||c_B||.

operations.input: Top-k safe pruning transferred to full output
operations.output: Pruned tail candidates still need certified relative order, so top-k safety is insufficient.

derivation_steps.statement: q c=q_A c_A+q_B c_B <= q_A c_A+||q_B||||c_B||.
derivation_steps.justification: Cauchy-Schwarz, with equality only for aligned residuals.

derivation_steps.statement: If UB<tau where tau is an exact kth-best score, the candidate cannot enter top-k.
derivation_steps.justification: At least k exact scores exceed UB; equality cannot safely resolve ties.

derivation_steps.statement: Two candidates both below tau can reverse their relative order through the unknown residual terms while retaining their bounds.
derivation_steps.justification: The top-k condition contains no information sufficient to order the full tail. Filling a truncated ranking would change native output.

method_expression: PARTIAL: a valid top-k rejection bound; no complete native ranking algorithm with accounted residual work and cost is derived.
distinguishing_prediction: Saving is possible only where required output allows certified unfinished residuals; full-ranking cost can eliminate the benefit.
falsifier: The returned native tail is invented/truncated, or exact complete-ranking/index/memory costs remove net savings.
closest_alternative: Known exact branch-and-bound/top-k search and early dot-product termination, not an automatic full-ranking algorithm.
decisive_comparison: Derive and measure full-ranking correctness/cost before dispatch; all released candidates and native tie behavior must be retained.
legacy_code_audit: Historically parked and no complete-ranking implementation. Existing full native scorer contract remains binding.
review_limit: Bound reviewed; native-output method_expression remains pending.
